race.comment: TURF LUCK (1) is the one to beat after placing in two of three starts before the break and winning a Hawkesbury trial in easy fashion. He may not have beaten much in the trial, but he was very impressive nonetheless and he'll give them something to catch from the front. CAPITAL BABE (2) disappointed before the break but knocked over her maiden in a good effort the start prior at this track. First-up here, but she maps for a kind run just off the speed and can resume on a positive note. PROPHET TIME (4) underperformed as a well-backed runner last time but had previously placed in a BM60 here. Boudvillain sticks and with the aid of an inside barrier, she can put her best foot forward. VAINSTREAM (3) quickly backs up after covering ground in a Cootamundra BM66 and was narrowly beaten here prior, making him a strong late contender among the main chances. SOHO SUSHI (6) just missed here last start and can be right in the finish on resumption.
